libraries.name: OpenMC official processed ENDF/B-VIII.1 data
libraries.version: ENDF/B-VIII.1; NJOY 2016.78; archive revision not pinned
libraries.usage_notes: Cross sections download page plus Data Configuration, Nuclear Data File Formats, Material Compositions and Execution Settings opened 2026-11-06. Live latest docs are not a pinned software release. ENDF to ACE via NJOY then HDF5 is processing, not a new measurement. ENDF/B-VIII.1 uses NJOY2016.78 and six neutron temperatures (250,293.6,600,900,1200,2500 K); thermal scattering has source-specific temperatures. Continuous-energy XML index and multigroup HDF5 are distinct contracts. HDF5 is hierarchical storage, not a validity certificate. OpenMC JENDL-5 archive says through update-16 while JAEA errata now includes later updates. No archives, checksums, license or actual runtime processing verified.
